#### Data infrastructure
Ingestion and QA/QC pipelines for lab instruments and field loggers, sample databases, and automated reports.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pillar}
#### Statistical modeling
Hierarchical Bayesian models (Stan/brms) of water chemistry, decomposition, and reservoir response to drought.
:::

#### Open tools
R packages and reusable workflows, shared openly where we can.
